# CLAIMs with `works` `conditions-of-correction`

*Works — A manuscript the record's claims are marshalled into. Membership says a claim is in the work; whether the record believes it is the status, and the two disagree (ADR-032).*

**Representation, Legibility, Learning, and the Conditions of Correction** — Article 1 of three drafted by ChatGPT on 2026-11-25 (A45 of the exchange "Hyper article interpretation", at the owner's U21), the hyperarticle atlas's first entry point: the record's theory of inquiry in the abstract. Inquiry is resource-bounded specification; a representation makes some differences consequential; legibility is relative to a decision; recognizing an error is not correcting it; learning needs more than retention; and inquiry must be able to reconsider its own apparatus. Its argument is held mainly in the lines learning-and-inquiry, records-of-inquiry and self-correction (ADR-145).

| [CLAIM-310](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-310.md) v3 | Sorting schemes over objects with determinate properties never conflict as descriptions, since the product of any sortings refines them all; they conflict as arrangements, since a fixed number of bins realizes one partition when each item is stored once, and which costs least depends on what is searched for and on what stands out within a bin | What is directionally right in the owner's LEGO monograph, as Mathematics of Meaning graded it. The disagreement is a trade, not a failure of global truth.
